newsitem.title: USA: Fleming Cos Inc completes recapitalization.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Cos Inc completes recapitalization.

text.p: Fleming Cos Inc said on Friday that it had completed its $1.35 billion recapitalization program, strengthening its capital structure.
The company said it completed the recapitalization by closing its new $850 million senior secured credit facility and selling $500 million in privately placed senior subordinated notes.

Proceeds from the senior subordinated notes plus initial borrowings were used to repay all outstanding bank debt, which totaled about $550 million, and to redeem the company's $200 million floating rate senior notes due 2001 on September 15, 1997, the food marketing company said in a statement.
